purpose: reading-comprehension items; the contradicted item is composed by the pipeline from basis+alter and always shown with its label

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Whole genome sequencing was run on DNA from diagnostic peripheral blood or bone marrow of 57 pediatric acute leukemia cases covering diverse genomic subtypes.
statements.evidence: We performed whole genome sequencing on DNA from diagnostic peripheral blood or bone marrow for 57 pediatric acute leukemia cases with diverse genomic subtypes.
statements.note: The abstract gives exactly this cohort size, sample types and subtype spread.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: In 18 cases analysed concurrently with sequencing, the driving alteration was pinpointed in as little as fifteen minutes for karyotype abnormalities.
statements.evidence: In 18 cases, we performed real-time analysis – concurrent with sequencing – and identified the driving alteration in as little as fifteen minutes (for karyotype) or up to six hours (for complex structural variants).
statements.note: Real-time analysis in 18 cases identified the driving alteration in as little as fifteen minutes for karyotype, and up to six hours for complex structural variants.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Nanopore classification changed the treatment assigned to patients whose standard-of-care testing had left the subtype unresolved.
statements.evidence: Whole genome nanopore sequencing with adaptive sampling has the potential to provide genomic classification of acute leukemia specimens with reduced cost and turnaround time compared to the current standard of care.
statements.note: The abstract claims potential savings in cost and turnaround time but reports no treatment decisions, and no case where standard testing failed.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Subtype-defining genomic alterations turned up in every case after at most forty-eight hours of sequencing.
statements.evidence: Subtype-defining genomic alterations were identified in all cases following a maximum of forty-eight hours of sequencing.
statements.note: This restates the abstract's result on completeness and the forty-eight-hour ceiling.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Carrying pK254-KPC_NDM slows the growth of Klebsiella michiganensis K254 when no antibiotic is present.
statements.evidence: The conjugal transfer and plasmid stability experiments confirmed that pK254-KPC_NDM could be transferred intercellularly and keep the stable vertical inheritance in different bacteria
statements.note: Transfer and stability were tested, but no growth rate or fitness cost of plasmid carriage is measured or implied.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Four Tn1696-related transposons carrying carbapenemase genes, Tn7414 to Tn7417, were compared by sequence; in all four, blaNDM-1 sat in Tn125 derivatives within three different mobile elements.
statements.evidence: A sequence comparison was applied to a collection of four Tn1696-related transposons (Tn7414-Tn7417) harbouring carbapenemase genes. For all these four transposons, the blaNDM-1 was carried by Tn125 derivatives within three different mobile genetic elements.
statements.note: The counts of transposons, Tn125-derivative carriage and three distinct mobile elements come straight from the results.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Conjugal transfer and stability experiments showed that pK254-KPC_NDM moves between cells and is stably inherited vertically in different bacteria.
statements.evidence: The conjugal transfer and plasmid stability experiments confirmed that pK254-KPC_NDM could be transferred intercellularly and keep the stable vertical inheritance in different bacteria
statements.note: Both properties, intercellular transfer and stable vertical inheritance, were confirmed experimentally.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: Tn7414 picked up the second carbapenemase gene blaKPC-2 when the local blaKPC-2 genetic environment from Tn6296 integrated, giving strain K254 high-level carbapenem resistance.
statements.evidence: Tn7414 further acquired another carbapenemase gene, blaKPC-2, because of the integration of the local blaKPC-2 genetic environment from Tn6296, resulting in the high-level carbapenem resistance of K. michiganensis K254.
statements.note: The abstract reports that the blaKPC-2 genetic environment came from Tn6296, not from Tn1696, the transposon family the element belongs to.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Of the selected junctions, 25 of 30 (83%) were detected in plasma, with detection in seven of the nine patients (78%).
statements.evidence: We detected 25/30 (83%) of selected junctions in the plasma of seven out of nine patients (78%).
statements.note: Both fractions and percentages are reported exactly this way in the results.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Detecting personalized junctions in plasma before therapy marked patients who went on to have shorter overall survival.
statements.evidence: Patient plasma obtained before therapy and at response assessment was tested for the presence of personalized junctions via quantitative polymerase chain reaction.
statements.note: Pre-therapy plasma was tested, but no survival or outcome analysis is reported, and none is ruled out.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: At follow-up, cfDNA junctions were found in three patients with persistent disease and were absent in a patient with no evidence of disease after surgery.

alter.from: were absent in a patient with no evidence of disease
alter.to: were equally abundant in a patient with no evidence of disease

statements.evidence: Cell-free junction detection at follow-up was concordant with disease status: cfDNA junctions were detected in three patients with persistent disease, and not detected in a patient with no evidence of disease after surgery.
statements.note: Follow-up detection tracked disease status: junctions were detected in the three patients with persistent disease and not detected in the patient with no evidence of disease after surgery.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The cohort was nine mesothelioma patients, four peritoneal and five pleural, and 763 chromosomal junctions were identified across their tumours.
statements.evidence: Our study included nine patients, four with peritoneal and five with pleural mesothelioma. 763 chromosomal junctions were identified in the tumors of all cases.
statements.note: Cohort composition and the total junction count are stated in the results.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: Comparison with 3 publicly available PDD genomes revealed both conserved core virulence determinants and strain-specific accessory genes reflecting local adaptation.
statements.evidence: Comparative analysis with 3 publicly available PDD genomes demonstrated both conserved core virulence determinants and strain-specific accessory genes, reflecting local adaptation and evolutionary diversification.
statements.note: Only 3 complete shrimp-derived PDD genomes were publicly available, and the comparison used those 3.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The study delivers complete, plasmid-resolved assemblies of four new PDD strains isolated from diseased Kuruma shrimp in several Japanese prefectures.
statements.evidence: we present complete, plasmid-resolved genome assemblies of 4 novel PDD strains (TUMSAT-PD1, -PD2, -PD3, and -PD4) isolated from diseased Kuruma shrimp across multiple prefectures in Japan.
statements.note: Four novel strains, plasmid-resolved assemblies and the multi-prefecture sampling are all stated.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Phylogenomics placed shrimp PDD strains as genetically heterogeneous and close to strains from other aquatic hosts, implying shrimp pathogenicity arose independently in several strains.
statements.evidence: Phylogenomic analysis reveals that shrimp PDD strains are genetically heterogeneous and closely related to those infecting other aquatic organisms, suggesting that pathogenicity against shrimp arose independently in multiple PDD strains.
statements.note: This is the phylogenomic result and the inference the abstract draws from it.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Plasmid-cured PDD strains killed fewer Kuruma shrimp than their wild-type counterparts in experimental challenge.
statements.evidence: While core virulence determinants are chromosomally encoded, we identified key plasmid-borne virulence factors that are likely to enhance the pathogenicity of PDD strains.
statements.note: Plasmid-borne virulence factors were identified from genome sequence; no infection experiment comparing cured and wild-type strains is reported.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Diversity within the L31 clade was high, and five phylogenetic clusters were resolved inside it.
statements.evidence: Rather high diversity was observed within the L31 clade; i.e., five phylogenetic clusters were identified.
statements.note: The cluster count and the high diversity are reported directly.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: L31 transposons constitute an independent superfamily of ancient origin inside the IS630/Tc1/mariner group.
statements.evidence: The L31 transposons were found to form an independent superfamily of an ancient origin within the ITm group.
statements.note: This is the placement the analysis established for L31.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The ORF2 protein cleaves target DNA during L31 transposition.
statements.evidence: A protein encoded by open reading frame 2 (ORF2) was shown to be an integral structural component of almost all full-length L31 elements.
statements.note: ORF2 is reported as a structural component of the elements; its biochemical activity is named as a question for future work, neither shown nor excluded.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: In mollusks, L31 elements were detected only in the subclass Autobranchia and predominate in diversity and number in the infraclass Pteriomorphia.
statements.evidence: In mollusks, the L31 transposons have been detected only in the subclass Autobranchia and predominate in diversity and number in the infraclass Pteriomorphia.
statements.note: Within mollusks, detection was restricted to the subclass Autobranchia, with the elements most diverse and numerous in Pteriomorphia.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Tumours in the ep300-perturbed animals shrank when treated with a CDK4 inhibitor.
statements.evidence: Together, these results establish an in vivo model that closely reflects the clinical situation on a pathway level and provides initial mechanistic insight into how adipocytic differentiation may become destabilized during disease progression.
statements.note: The model is presented for mechanistic insight; no drug treatment or therapeutic response is tested or ruled out.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: Perturbing the transcriptional co-activator ep300 on top of the p53 and Rb pathway hits increased tumor dedifferentiation, giving lesions with spatially coexisting well- and dedifferentiated adipocytic states.
statements.evidence: Strikingly, additional perturbation of transcriptional co-activator ep300 in this context resulted in increased tumor dedifferentiation, yielding lesions composed of spatially coexisting well- and dedifferentiated adipocytic states.
statements.note: Additional ep300 perturbation increased dedifferentiation and produced lesions with coexisting well- and dedifferentiated states.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Disrupting MDM2-p53 and CDK4-Rb pathway components together in Xenopus tropicalis embryos reproducibly induced retroperitoneal well-differentiated liposarcoma, showing pathway-level deregulation suffices to initiate the disease.
statements.evidence: Combined disruption reproducibly induced retroperitoneal WDLPS development, demonstrating that pathway-level deregulation of the MDM2–p53 and CDK4–Rb axes is sufficient to initiate liposarcoma development in vivo
statements.note: This is the initiation result and the sufficiency claim the abstract makes from it.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Directly knocking out the downstream adipogenic regulators cebpa, g0s2 and dgat2 produced no dedifferentiation in the same genetic context.
statements.evidence: direct targeted disruption of downstream adipogenic regulators recurrently lost in human DDLPS, including cebpa , g0s2 , and dgat2 , failed to induce dedifferentiation in the same genetic context in vivo
statements.note: The abstract reports this negative result for the downstream effectors, in contrast to ep300.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Two human pluripotent cell models carrying a single functional DGCR8 allele were generated to work out the gene's role in early development.
statements.evidence: In this study, we generated two human pluripotent cell models containing a single functional DGCR8 allele to elucidate its role in early development.
statements.note: The number of models and the single functional allele are stated as the study design.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: DGCR8+/- hESCs showed a pronounced reduction in expression of HERVH, a primate-specific retroelement essential for maintaining pluripotency.
statements.evidence: DGCR8+/- hESCs also displayed a pronounced reduction in human endogenous retrovirus class H (HERVH) expression, a primate-specific retroelement essential for pluripotency maintenance.
statements.note: HERVH expression was pronouncedly reduced in DGCR8+/- hESCs, and KLF4 mediated that downregulation.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: DGCR8+/- human embryonic stem cells had raised apoptosis together with self-renewal and differentiation defects in both the naive and primed states.
statements.evidence: DGCR8+/- human embryonic stem cells (hESCs) showed increased apoptosis as well as self-renewal and differentiation defects in both the naïve and primed states.
statements.note: All three phenotypes, and their presence in both pluripotency states, are reported.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Neurons differentiated from DGCR8+/- cells reproduce the cognitive features of people with 22q11.2 deletion syndrome.
statements.evidence: The 22q11.2 deletion syndrome (22qDS) is a human disorder where the majority of clinical manifestations originate during embryonic development.
statements.note: Clinical manifestations appear only as background; no neuronal differentiation or patient-phenotype comparison is reported.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: Besides the genes under positive selection, some genes in the oral epithelium showed evidence of negative selection.
statements.evidence: with 49 genes under positive selection driving clonal expansions in the oral epithelium, over 62,000 driver mutations, and evidence of negative selection in some genes
statements.note: The abstract reports evidence of negative selection in some genes alongside the 49 positively selected ones.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Targeted NanoSeq on 1,042 oral epithelium samples and 371 blood samples from a twin cohort found 49 genes under positive selection and over 62,000 driver mutations.
statements.evidence: Applying targeted NanoSeq to 1,042 non-invasive samples of oral epithelium and 371 samples of blood from a twin cohort, we found an unprecedentedly rich landscape of selection, with 49 genes under positive selection driving clonal expansions in the oral epithelium, over 62,000 driver mutations
statements.note: Sample counts, the number of positively selected genes and the driver mutation total match the reported landscape.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Clonal expansions in the oral epithelium were larger in smoking twins than in their non-smoking co-twins.
statements.evidence: Multivariate regression models enable mutational epidemiology studies on how carcinogenic exposures and cancer risk factors, such as age, tobacco or alcohol, alter the acquisition and selection of somatic mutations.
statements.note: The abstract says such exposure analyses are now possible but gives no result for smoking-discordant twins in either direction.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The new NanoSeq version is a duplex sequencing method with fewer than five errors per billion base pairs that works with whole-exome and targeted gene sequencing.
statements.evidence: a duplex sequencing method with error rates <5 errors per billion base pairs, which is compatible with whole-exome and targeted gene sequencing
statements.note: The error rate and the compatibility with exome and targeted panels are both stated.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Sequencing 962 clear cell renal cell carcinomas from 11 countries of differing incidence showed that somatic mutation profiles varied between countries.
statements.evidence: Here we sequenced 962 clear cell renal cell carcinomas from 11 countries with varying incidence. The somatic mutation profiles differed between countries.
statements.note: Tumour count, number of countries and the between-country difference are reported together.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: In Romania, Serbia and Thailand the aristolochic acid exposure came mainly through contaminated drinking water.
statements.evidence: In Romania, Serbia and Thailand, mutational signatures characteristic of aristolochic acid compounds were present in most cases, but these were rare elsewhere.
statements.note: The signature's presence in those countries is reported; the route or source of exposure is neither investigated nor excluded.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: A mutational signature of unknown cause was present in more than 70% of Japanese cases and in fewer than 2% of cases elsewhere.
statements.evidence: In Japan, a mutational signature of unknown cause was found in more than 70% of cases but in less than 2% elsewhere.
statements.note: Both percentages and the country contrast are as reported.

statements.label: contradicted
statements.basis: Known tobacco smoking signatures tracked tobacco consumption, while no signature was associated with obesity or hypertension.

alter.from: no signature was associated with obesity or hypertension
alter.to: separate signatures were associated with both obesity and hypertension

statements.evidence: Known signatures of tobacco smoking correlated with tobacco consumption, but no signature was associated with obesity or hypertension, suggesting that non-mutagenic mechanisms of action underlie these risk factors.
statements.note: No signature was associated with obesity or hypertension, which the abstract reads as evidence for non-mutagenic mechanisms behind those risk factors.
